name: MrLTTec Home
subtitle: Control the TVs, speakers and lights on any Wi-Fi.
localizedDescription: A take-anywhere smart home tool. Join any Wi-Fi, tap Discover, and control what's on that network: Sonos (now playing, volume, EQ, grouping, favorites, sleep timer), Roku and Samsung TV remotes with apps and typing, WiZ lights (color, white, scenes), WLED strips (color, effects), Wemo and WiZ plugs, and turning on an Xbox. Includes network tools: every device on the network, ping, port checks and Wake-on-LAN. No account, PC or internet needed.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Finds and controls the TVs, speakers and lights on the Wi-Fi you are connected to.
